dag_infos.description: DGBAS 2020 Population and Housing Census commuting/work-location categories for New Taipei City.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市通勤通學普查流向
data_infos.source_type: DGBAS server-rendered catalog and XML resource
data_infos.dataset_description: 2020 population and housing census work-location categories for people aged 15 and over who have work; the machine-readable resource does not contain age or destination-city fields.
data_infos.etl_description: Download the official XML resource with a browser User-Agent, locate the New Taipei record by role aliases, reconcile the three mutually exclusive flow scopes to the source grand total, and emit one city-level row per flow scope. The 18-35 result is unavailable: age is not present, and no age or destination-city inference is made.
